content: Kodi add-on settings format. The <settings> element must carry version='1' or the <section> element is not recognised; structure is settings/section/category/group/setting. The new format landed in Kodi 18 Leia but was buggy; Kodi 19 Matrix fixed it and conversion is recommended from Matrix onward. Definition lives in <addon>/resources/settings.xml; VALUES live separately in userdata/addon_data/<addon.id>/settings.xml and are keyed by setting id - they are NOT touched by an add-on upgrade. Consequence: renaming or deleting a setting id orphans the stored value rather than clearing it, and a setting whose id still exists keeps whatever the user (or an old default) stored. Kodi substitutes the add-on id from addon.xml for every  token in the settings definition. Add-ons that need to move values across ids must run an explicit migration in code on first run after upgrade. Community tooling exists (script.settings-convert) but a backup of settings.xml is advised before conversion.
